list.name: adjudicante
list.label: Adjudicante (name or NIF)
list.description: One or more buyers (the dashboard aggregates them as a union).
list.query: SELECT name || ' — ' || entity_id AS __text, entity_id AS __value FROM procurement.entities_adjudicantes ORDER BY name, entity_id

list.name: min_contract_value
list.label: Min contract value (EUR)
list.description: Minimum absolute contract value in EUR. Contracts with abs(preco_contratual) below this are hidden from every panel. It is applied to the absolute value, so large negative values are kept. It works on top of the fixed EUR 10 rule used at ingest (contracts below EUR 10 are already excluded). Options: 0 (no extra filter), 10, 5000, 20000, 75000. The default is 10.

list.name: show_all_contract_types
list.label: Show all contract types
list.description: Off: contract type is grouped into procedure families (Ajuste direto, Concurso público, Consulta prévia, Other). On: contract type lists every individual tipo_procedimento (20 values). Switching resets the Contract type selection to All when the previous values do not exist in the new list.

list.name: contract_type
list.label: Contract type
list.query: SELECT text AS __text, value AS __value FROM procurement.v_contract_type_options WHERE mode = '${show_all_contract_types}' ORDER BY sort, text
list.description: Procedure family (procedure_family, from contracts.tipo_procedimento); Other = every procedure outside the three named families. Turn on 'Show all contract types' to filter by the exact tipo_procedimento instead.

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT sum(a.preco_contratual) AS val FROM procurement.v_adjudicatario_contracts a WHERE a.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ',')) AND (a.celebrated_at >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND a.celebrated_at < date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamp) + interval '1 day') AND abs(a.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value} AND ('__ALL__' = ANY(ARRAY[${contract_type:sqlstring}]) OR (CASE WHEN '${show_all_contract_types}' = 'on' THEN a.tipo_procedimento ELSE a.procedure_family END) = ANY(ARRAY[${contract_type:sqlstring}])) GROUP BY a.adjudicatario_id), t AS (SELECT val / nullif(sum(val) OVER (), 0) AS sh, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY val DESC) AS rn FROM s) SELECT sum(sh) FILTER (WHERE rn <= 10) AS top10_share FROM t

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS rows_shown FROM (SELECT v.idcontrato FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ',')) AND (v.celebrated_at >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND v.celebrated_at < date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamp) + interval '1 day') AND abs(v.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value} AND ('__ALL__' = ANY(ARRAY[${contract_type:sqlstring}]) OR (CASE WHEN '${show_all_contract_types}' = 'on' THEN v.tipo_procedimento ELSE v.procedure_family END) = ANY(ARRAY[${contract_type:sqlstring}])) LIMIT 5000) t

panels.description: The table below is capped at LIMIT 5000 rows, newest first; this count makes a silent truncation visible.

targets.rawSql: SELECT v.celebrated_at AS "Date", a.adjudicatario_names AS "Adjudicatário(s)", v.objecto_contrato AS "Objecto", v.preco_contratual AS "Preço", v.preco_total_efetivo AS "Preço efetivo", v.prazo_execucao AS "Prazo (d)", v.valor_por_dia AS "EUR/dia", v.tipo_procedimento AS "Procedimento", v.cpv AS "CPV", v.idcontrato AS "ID" FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT string_agg(a2.adjudicatario_name, ', ' ORDER BY a2.adjudicatario_name) AS adjudicatario_names FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario a2 WHERE a2.idcontrato = v.idcontrato) a ON true WHERE v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ',')) AND (v.celebrated_at >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND v.celebrated_at < date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamp) + interval '1 day') AND abs(v.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value} AND ('__ALL__' = ANY(ARRAY[${contract_type:sqlstring}]) OR (CASE WHEN '${show_all_contract_types}' = 'on' THEN v.tipo_procedimento ELSE v.procedure_family END) = ANY(ARRAY[${contract_type:sqlstring}])) ORDER BY v.celebrated_at DESC LIMIT 5000
